environment: Same-host Apple M4 macOS loopback; server 10 Tokio workers; frozen loadgen 4 workers.

methodology.rate_formula: real accepted receipts / fixed 30-second measurement window
methodology.sink: Immediate required AuditSink; real webhook/confirmed stream covered by correctness tests, not this throughput experiment.
methodology.ordering: All before trials then all after trials; serialized, without compilation/tests. No randomized or interleaved treatment.
methodology.latency: Successful receipt histogram; excludes unconfirmed/rejected attempts. Not a loss-free capacity claim.
methodology.worker_correction: Before raw loadgen_tokio_workers=2 is requested environment only; executable explicitly used 4 in both treatments. See metadata-corrections.json.

after.dependency_count_scope: unique package/version pairs in native cargo tree normal edges, excluding SDK root

validation.ignored_tests: Four remain ignored in the normal workspace suites. Relevant restart soak run explicitly; not all ignored diagnostics were run.

limitations: 30-second loopback windows, N=3; no confidence interval or production capacity certification.
Stream modes deliberately approach admission limits; report accepted/offered and disconnects alongside rate.
UDP is sessionless and unencrypted; recent in-memory state can be lost on abrupt crash.
No replacement automatic device config-pull protocol. Management configuration and application commands remain.
No separate-host, multi-hour soak, power-loss or syscall profiling in this task.
